statements.t: (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) (“Figure”), the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale, and trading of tokenized assets, today reported select unaudited preliminary operating data for the month and quarter ended September 30, 2026 that was at the high end of the Company’s previously issued guidance range of $4.8B - $5.2B.
The Company’s previously issued Q3 2026 guidance did not include the contribution of Kiavi.
Prior-period volumes will be recast following our next quarterly earnings release.
